newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania Banca Agricola cuts leu depo rates.
newsitem.headline: Romania Banca Agricola cuts leu depo rates.

text.p: Romanian state-run bank Banca Agricola SA (BA) said on Monday it had cut interest rates on leu deposits and credits in line with slower inflation.
A bank statement said individuals' sight deposit rates had slipped to an annual 14 percent from 15 percent, while one- month deposits carried 39 percent against 49 previously.
It said the bank, a farm lender, had slashed lending rates by five to 10 percentage points to help economic recovery, especially in agriculture. The rates now range from 42 to 55 percent annually.
The move follows recent cuts in interest rates on the market after monthly inflation had dropped to a record low of 0.7 percent in July from 2.3 percent the previous month.
The BA's three-month deposits for individuals now pay a 42 percent annual interest, down from 54 percent previously, while six-month deposit rates fell to 44 percent from 58 percent.
The rate on one-year deposits dipped to 50 from 62 percent.
BA is to be restructured this year before plans to oput it into private hands, under a bank selloff bill.
